a: A lost WebGL context leaves the host failing every render for good
A page that crashed between renders fails the next render although the host already knows
A failing cleanup in `open` hides the error that caused it
b: sceneToWire decodes a live Scene's `toJSON()` as if it were encoded, so node data shaped like a codec tag changes type or value on the way to the page
`difference` compares only `a.length` bytes and goes `NaN` on a length mismatch, so a short or empty node raster can read as identical
The page's `toBase64` builds a binary string the size of the raster, so a large render fails with V8's "Invalid string length" instead of a usable error
